name: separator
title: Separator
description: A thin line between groups that spacing alone does not separate, optionally with a short label.

when: Two groups of content need a visible boundary.

instead.when: The groups are separate objects; give each its own card.

guidance.rule: Prefer space over lines; add a separator only when space is not enough.

builtIn: Exposed as a separator with its orientation.

genui.description: A divider line between groups; children are an optional short label such as "or".
